name: actionable-philosophy-book-club
description: Static SPA for philosophy book club meetings

scripts.build:js: node scripts/inline-manifest.cjs && terser src/_manifest.js src/00-setup.js src/01-utils.js src/02-manifest.js src/03-assets.js src/04-dashboard.js src/05-reader.js src/06-app.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o dist/app.js && terser src/theme-init.js --compress --mangle -o dist/theme-init.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:js
